plan.summary: Lowers the export batch size from 2000 to 500 rows, so exports write at most 500 rows per batch. The PR also holds small cleanups: a variable rename in the avatar code, a removed debug log in the menu code, and a README typo fix.
plan.riskRationale: One constant changes. It lowers batch size, which can slow exports but keeps the batching logic the same. The other edits have no behavior effect, except the removed console.log, which has no effect on returned values.
plan.storyArc: The only behavior change is the smaller export batch size. The remaining hunks are cleanup and docs that need no explanation.

noise.reason: Variable rename only. The returned value is the same.

topics.title: Export batch size reduced to 500 rows
topics.narrativeBrief: What does lowering BATCH_ROWS from 2000 to 500 change for exports? Verify that batches() uses BATCH_ROWS as the chunk size, so each batch holds at most 500 rows.

topics.title: Remove debug log from openMenu
topics.narrativeBrief: openMenu no longer logs its inputs. Confirm the returned list is unchanged and only the console side effect is gone.
